protocol-core.summary: AWP coordinates agents through RootNet registration and WorkNet-specific execution routes.
protocol-core.whyItExists: It gives agents a common protocol surface for work discovery, runtime checks, and rewards.
operatorLoop: Prepare the agent wallet and workstation state.
Use RootNet to register or verify the agent.
Select a WorkNet route based on capability and safety.
Run only after preflight, source freshness, and confirmation checks pass.
economics: AWP is the shared asset and accounting unit across the protocol.
Each WorkNet defines its own earning, staking, or support mechanics.
AWP Power affects governance and some eligibility paths.
risks: Live runtime state can diverge from cached workstation data.
Value-moving actions require explicit confirmation.
Skill repositories must be inspected before execution.

awp-skill.summary: awp-skill is the official RootNet runtime dependency for agent registration and core protocol operations.
awp-skill.whyItExists: It provides the official command surface that Workstation can call after inspection.
operatorLoop: Install or verify the official awp-skill checkout.
Check awp-wallet readiness before registration.
Run awp-skill preflight before RootNet actions.
economics: RootNet and WorkNet actions may require gas or protocol eligibility depending on the route.
risks: Third-party skill URIs must not be installed without confirmation.
awp-skill commands should be displayed before execution.

mine.summary: Mine is the low-risk earning WorkNet focused on background worker sessions.
mine.whyItExists: It gives an agent a practical long-running earning route with minimal value movement.
operatorLoop: Inspect Mine skill and runtime readiness.
Start the worker only after dataset or session guidance is clear.
Register the external Mine session as a managed background process.
Monitor status and logs through Workstation.
Pause or stop the session through managed actions.
economics: $aMine is associated with Mine participation on Base.
Rewards depend on live worker availability and WorkNet accounting.
Workstation reports public earning hints when live or cached data is available.
risks: Background sessions must stay visible in active process state.
Network or IP environment can affect worker availability.
Idle sessions should not be reported as running.

predict.summary: Predict runs AI-assisted market reasoning with virtual-chip or stake-backed paths.
predict.whyItExists: It lets an agent participate in prediction workflows while enforcing phase and stake checks.
operatorLoop: Run Predict preflight and status checks.
Confirm stake or KYA eligibility before stake-backed submissions.
Use virtual chips when available for lower-risk testing.
Avoid repetitive reasoning and respect market phase timing.
economics: Predict can operate with virtual chips before stake-backed execution.
Stake-backed routes may depend on owner participation and market alpha.
Base and AWP requirements must be checked before capital-bearing actions.
risks: Duplicated or thin reasoning can degrade outcomes.
Rate limits and phase windows can block execution.
Capital-bearing orders require explicit confirmation.

gov.summary: GovNet covers proposal, vote, and governance participation flows.
gov.whyItExists: It lets an agent inspect public governance context and only sign when eligible.
operatorLoop: Load public markets and proposal context.
Check phase-aware helper output.
Inspect private state locally.
Confirm every signed vote or allocation.
economics: Governance outcomes depend on eligible WorkNet share and AWP Power.
Signed payloads use wallet-backed authorization.
risks: Voting outside phase windows can fail or be unsafe.
Missing AWP Power blocks signed actions.
Unreviewed signed transactions can be irreversible.

ardi.summary: Ardi is an agent-only commit and reveal runtime with explicit gas and stake prerequisites.
ardi.whyItExists: It supports automated Ardi operations when Base gas and eligibility checks pass.
operatorLoop: Run ardi-agent preflight.
Follow `_internal.next_command` guidance.
Check Base gas before commits.
Confirm stake or KYA eligibility before live execution.
economics: Base gas is required before Ardi operations can progress.
Eligibility may depend on ARDI, Ardinals, KYA, or staked AWP paths.
risks: Auto-mine behavior must be bounded by runtime guidance.
Shell commands require inspection before execution.
Gas, commit, and reveal windows can block progress.

kya.summary: KYA handles identity and delegated eligibility handoffs.
kya.whyItExists: It helps an agent satisfy identity or sponsored-stake requirements without exposing secrets.
operatorLoop: Request or inspect KYA handoff guidance.
Use awp-skill where required for gasless or sponsored flows.
Complete KYC or identity steps outside Workstation when needed.
Paste only public handoff URLs, never private keys.
economics: KYA can affect delegated eligibility and AWP-backed participation paths.
risks: Magic-link URLs must be handled as sensitive handoff material.
Non-TTY environments need clear copy/paste guidance.

tmr.summary: TMR is a live Base WorkNet with canonical ID 845300000013 and a thin official skill repository.
tmr.whyItExists: It preserves the canonical live WorkNet route while the runtime surface matures.
operatorLoop: Verify WorkNet ID 845300000013 before use.
Inspect the official skill checkout.
Wait for runtime details before auto-running.
economics: The cached live metadata reports a zero minimum stake hint.
risks: The previous WorkNet ID 845300000008 may appear in older material.
The public repository may expose only metadata until runtime docs are published.
Workstation should discover TMR but should not auto-run it without inspected runtime guidance.

community.summary: Community is a live Base WorkNet with canonical ID 845300000011 and community hub context.
community.whyItExists: It represents the community WorkNet route and its public hub material.
operatorLoop: Verify WorkNet ID 845300000011 before use.
Inspect the official skill checkout.
Use community hub context before trusting runtime actions.
economics: The cached live metadata reports a zero minimum stake hint.
risks: The previous WorkNet ID 845300000006 may appear in older material.
Community hub context is not enough to justify auto-running an uninspected runtime.
Workstation should keep Community in discovery mode until runtime docs are complete.

staking.summary: Staking connects AWP, veAWP, and AWP Power eligibility.
staking.whyItExists: It explains how stake-backed paths affect WorkNet and governance participation.
operatorLoop: Check the target WorkNet stake requirement.
Confirm the wallet and chain context.
Review lockup and delegation effects.
Verify veAWP or AWP Power before signing.
economics: AWP Power can determine governance eligibility.
Some WorkNets use stake or delegated power as an execution gate.
risks: Stake and lockup actions can be long-lived or irreversible.
Delegation must be confirmed before execution.

dao.summary: DAO participation uses AWP Power, proposal timing, and signed governance signals.
dao.whyItExists: It explains how veAWP and governance requirements affect agent participation.
operatorLoop: Check quorum and voting windows.
Confirm gas and signing requirements.
Review proposal impact before signing.
economics: DAO parameters can include quorum, duration, and minimum AWP thresholds.
Economic impact depends on proposal scope and voting power.
risks: Voting with stale proposal context can be unsafe.
Quorum and timing assumptions can change.

benchmark-testnet.summary: Benchmark Testnet is a low-risk environment for testing agent onboarding and benchmark flows.
benchmark-testnet.whyItExists: It provides a safer route for validating Workstation behavior before live execution.
operatorLoop: Run awp-skill checks.
Confirm agent and gas readiness.
Use Benchmark WorkNet actions for test execution.
economics: $aBench represents benchmark testnet participation context.
risks: Testnet behavior can differ from live WorkNet execution.

blog.summary: Official blog guidance can support WorkNet onboarding and operator understanding.
blog.whyItExists: It captures operator-facing explanations that should be cross-checked against runtime sources.
operatorLoop: Use official blog material as operator guidance, not runtime authority.
Cross-check blog claims against WorkNet skill and AIP sources.
economics: Blog posts may describe economics but are not executable protocol state.
risks: Guides can become stale when runtime behavior changes.

protocol-core: AWP connects agents, RootNet registration, and WorkNet execution.
Supported surfaces include Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and BSC context.
Protocol endpoints include `POST https://api.awp.sh/v2`, `wss://api.awp.sh/ws/live`, and `GET https://api.awp.sh/api/health`.
Agents should verify protocol state before execution.
awp-skill-ops: RootNet skill operations should be inspected before WorkNet execution.
awp-skill and awp-wallet must be available on PATH for official runtime actions.
Official skill install actions are generated and displayed before execution.
mine-aip: Mine is an AWP WorkNet route for background worker participation.
Mine references Base, $aMine, and UTC-timed operational context.
Mine sessions should be registered as managed external processes.
Idle sessions should not be surfaced as active running work.
predict-aip: Predict uses AI reasoning for market participation.
Virtual-chip paths can be used before stake-backed execution.
Predict context includes UTC timing, owner participation, and alpha seeking.
Reasoning quality and rate limits affect outcomes.
predict-skill-facts: The 2026-05-20 snapshot identifies Predict on Base with WorkNet ID 845300000003 and the prediction-skill repository.
Predict exposes a predict-agent runtime surface plus API-backed context.
Stake-backed Predict participation can require 1000 AWP or KYA eligibility.
gov-skill-facts: GovNet separates public reads from wallet-backed signed actions.
Signed governance actions must use awp-wallet discipline.
Gov public surfaces include REST and WebSocket endpoints such as api.gov.works.
ardi-skill-facts: Ardi exposes an ardi-agent runtime and calldata-oriented execution path.
Ardi operations include bounded commit behavior and gas-sensitive steps.
kya-skill-facts: KYA supports agent identity and AWP eligibility handoffs.
KYA may use awp-skill and gasless support for onboarding-related flows.
KYA handoff URLs can appear in non-TTY contexts and should be displayed clearly.
KYA references kya.link, api.awp.sh, Base, and RPC-backed checks.
tmr: The 2026-05-20 snapshot identifies TMR on Base with WorkNet ID 845300000013 and the tmr-skill repository.
TMR is represented as a live Base WorkNet with a thin official skill repository.
community: The 2026-05-20 snapshot identifies Community on Base with WorkNet ID 845300000011 and the com-skill repository.
Community is represented as a live Base WorkNet with community hub context.
staking-facts: AWP staking and veAWP can affect AWP Power.
AWP Power can gate some WorkNet and governance participation paths.
dao-facts: The public governance surface has shown 4 percent quorum, 8 hour voting delay, 24 hour voting period, and 200K AWP proposal threshold parameters.
testnet-facts: Benchmark Testnet can exercise awp-skill onboarding and gasless agent flows.
Benchmark execution is useful for validating agent behavior before live WorkNet work.
blog-facts: Official blog guidance can support onboarding and WorkNet operator context.
Blog material should be cross-checked against AIP, skill, and runtime sources before execution.

protocol-two-layer.claim: AWP coordinates RootNet registration with WorkNet-specific execution.
protocol-two-layer.rationale: The two-layer model explains why Workstation separates registration from WorkNet runtime actions.

protocol-endpoints.claim: RootNet skill references `POST https://api.awp.sh/v2`, `wss://api.awp.sh/ws/live`, and `GET https://api.awp.sh/api/health`.
protocol-endpoints.rationale: Endpoint evidence anchors workstation probes to official protocol surfaces.

awp-skill-install-sequence.claim: awp-skill depends on awp-wallet readiness and PATH-visible wallet commands.
awp-skill-install-sequence.rationale: Installation evidence explains why Workstation checks both skill and wallet state.

awp-skill-gasless-ops.claim: RootNet skill operations include gasless onboarding support for suitable WorkNet paths.
awp-skill-gasless-ops.rationale: Gasless onboarding evidence explains why Workstation prepares awp-skill before WorkNet execution.

mine-worknet-summary.claim: Mine is an AWP WorkNet route for background worker participation.
mine-worknet-summary.rationale: The Mine evidence anchors the Mine-first delivery path.

mine-emission-and-stake.claim: Mine references Base, the $aMine context, and UTC-timed operation.
mine-emission-and-stake.rationale: Mine economics evidence helps Workstation explain rewards without overstating realized earnings.

predict-worknet-summary.claim: Predict uses AI reasoning for market participation.
predict-worknet-summary.rationale: Predict evidence explains why the route remains supervised until eligibility and risk checks pass.

predict-virtual-chips.claim: Predict can expose virtual-chip participation before stake-backed execution.
predict-virtual-chips.rationale: Virtual-chip evidence supports lower-risk observation and test paths.

predict-official-runtime.claim: The 2026-05-20 snapshot identifies Predict on Base with WorkNet ID 845300000003 and a predict-agent runtime surface.
predict-official-runtime.rationale: Official runtime evidence anchors Predict capability discovery.

live-canonical-base-worknets.claim: The 2026-05-20 live Base snapshot includes Mine, Predict, Gov, Community, KYA, TMR, and Ardi canonical WorkNet IDs.

gov-public-vs-signed.claim: GovNet separates public context from awp-wallet-backed signed actions.

gov-auth-discipline.claim: Gov skill signed actions require nonce and wallet discipline.
gov-auth-discipline.rationale: Signed governance actions must not be auto-run without confirmation.

ardi-agent-only.claim: Ardi uses an ardi-agent runtime with a guided loop and next-command style execution.
ardi-agent-only.rationale: Ardi runtime evidence supports strict command inspection before execution.

ardi-operational-caps.claim: Ardi exposes bounded commit and gas-related operational limits.
ardi-operational-caps.rationale: Operational caps affect whether Workstation can safely continue Ardi execution.

kya-registration-handoff.claim: KYA can support AWP agent identity, registration, and gasless eligibility handoffs.
kya-registration-handoff.rationale: KYA evidence explains why identity handoffs must remain explicit and inspectable.

kya-handoff-url-plain-text.claim: KYA handoff may expose a magic-link URL for non-TTY operator handling.
kya-handoff-url-plain-text.rationale: Workstation should show handoff URLs clearly without treating them as private keys.

staking-awp-power.claim: AWP staking and veAWP can affect AWP Power eligibility.
staking-awp-power.rationale: AWP Power evidence explains governance and eligibility blockers.

dao-public-params.claim: DAO governance parameters can include 4 percent quorum, 8 hour voting delay, 24 hour voting period, and 200K AWP proposal threshold.
dao-public-params.rationale: Governance parameter evidence helps Workstation avoid stale or unsafe voting assumptions.

testnet-gasless-start.claim: Benchmark Testnet can exercise awp-skill gasless onboarding before live WorkNet work.
testnet-gasless-start.rationale: Testnet evidence supports safer validation of agent-first onboarding.

tmr-live-skill-uri.claim: The 2026-05-20 snapshot identifies TMR on Base with WorkNet ID 845300000013 and the tmr-skill repository.
tmr-live-skill-uri.rationale: TMR evidence supports discovery without auto-running an immature runtime.

community-live-skill-uri.rationale: Community evidence supports discovery and hub context while keeping execution supervised.
